refinement.assumptions: Blue lines parallel and equally spaced about center; far board/floor edge is straight. Relative coordinate system only; center-circle origin retained.
refinement.method: Robust global homography correction from raw paint/board marks on three frames. Other reference frames are withheld from the fit. Per-frame camera registration remains automatic.

heldout.scope: Assistant-marked image-to-line alignment on 7 development frames. Measures consistency with approximate rink template, not surveyed floor-position error, identity accuracy or out-of-game generalization.

fit.scope: Assistant-marked image-to-line alignment on 3 development frames. Measures consistency with approximate rink template, not surveyed floor-position error, identity accuracy or out-of-game generalization.
